The admitting DoDatastore is constructed FROM the sweep and the only producer of a sweep arms the alarm, so 'no safe intermediate state where 6 exists alone' is a value rather than a rule. Only /dht/ is lifted; /o2/ stays refused. The assembly's decisions are exported as data so a spec can read them outside kadDHT()'s closure. OPEN QUESTION 1 IS ANSWERED: noise reaches the bundle after all (43 occurrences in 583.94 KiB) because tree-shaking is per-symbol, so hosted-tier-deploy's diffieHellman case is a live green reading instead of a loud skip. createHostedFabric is deliberately uncalled until Phase 30's listener; ten reachability rows added, ceiling 87 -> 97. WHAT STAYS OPEN AND IS REPORTED, NOT SIMULATED: that an alarm survives eviction and fires on a fresh instance, and that this configuration dials and is dialled. CLOSED 2026-08-26 in caa46c6 — Phase 30 requirement 4. A revived socket is CLOSED with 1012, not resumed: Noise has no session resumption and yamux no resync, so every alternative is a connection that lies about being live. The registry is keyed by socket identity, so the miss IS the detection. FIVE PLANTS WATCHED RED. The route is wired, so createHostedFabric has a production caller — bundle 583.94 -> 1867.80 KiB, kadDHT 0 -> 11, and diffieHellman/node:crypto STILL 0. §17's claim is deliberately narrowed in the prose: yamux defaults enableKeepAlive at 30 s, so an object under a live connection will not hibernate at all and the proven win is only the six-minute abort. TAMING THE KEEPALIVE IS A NAMED OPEN DECISION, NOT TAKEN — a peer that never sends cannot detect a dead path. Also open and reported: whether workerd accepts 1012 (1011 is known accepted), and whether binaryType may be assigned on a hibernatable socket, deliberately not asserted either way. Phase 30 criteria 1-3 need >5 distinct clients against a deployed node and stay owner acts.

decisions.decision: Six new cloudflare symbols to OPEN_FINDINGS, not DISPOSITIONS
